query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:00:00.000Z"
        AND host.ip == "172.18.0.6"
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
